sentences.text: Every boat needs reliable bilge pumping.
Automatic electric pumps with float switches handle small leaks and rainwater, and a high-water alarm audible at the helm warns you when something is wrong.
Carry a manual pump as a backup in case of electrical failure.
Remember that a pump’s rated capacity drops sharply with the height it lifts water and the length of its hose, so real-world output is much less than the label.
Most importantly, know where every through-hull fitting on your boat is, so you can find a leak fast.
